hey, i'm clarissa!

i'm one of the co-founders of clean (yc f26). we give companiesamazing for manufacturing tech, notary tech, insurance tech, and other niche industries. prospects backed by real-world data, not just website visits or clicks.

along the way i got honorable mentions at IPhO and APhO, received a full-ride scholarship from Indonesia and Singapore, interned as the youngest SWE at ruangguru (southeast asia's largest edtech company), starred on a game show, won 10+ hackathons, developed the autonomy stack at triton robotics, and researched about path planning and goal-based learning at the existential robotics lab.

i like robots, reinforcement learning, specialized harnesses, physics, and history. i also post on instagram and tiktok, which gained me 150k+ followers. oh, and go tritons!
